# Casa del Jaguar – Ayahuasca Iquitos

Ayahuasca retreat centre in the city of Iquitos, Peru, at Calle Jaén 454. Not affiliated with any hotel of the same name.

Founded in 2008 by Dan Reynolds, who led the ceremonies until 2014. He died in 2021. Since 2014, Maestro Denis Montes has led the ceremonies together with indigenous shamans. Denis guides the whole programme. Ceremonies are in English, and Denis translates.

Phone and WhatsApp: +51 917 811 803
Email: info@casadeljaguariquitos.com
RetreatsMap place: https://retreatsmap.com/places/casa-del-jaguar
RetreatsMap event: https://retreatsmap.com/events/7-day-ayahuasca-holistic-wellness-retreat-in-iquitos-peru

## Home

https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/
https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/en/

Casa del Jaguar – Ayahuasca Iquitos offers a 7-day, 6-night ayahuasca retreat in the city, minutes from the airport. The price is $2,800 USD for every room. Groups are a maximum of 8 people. Ceremonies are in the maloca at Calle Jaén 454. Indigenous shamans lead them with Denis Montes. Between ceremonies there is yoga, breathing, meditation and Hemi-Sync, a recorded sound for quiet concentration, plus integration workshops. Two guided Amazon excursions happen on days without a ceremony. The centre picks guests up at Coronel FAP Francisco Secada Vignetta Airport.

## Pricing

https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/pricing/
https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/en/pricing/

The retreat costs $2,800 USD for 7 days and 6 nights. Every room is the same price. Rooms have air conditioning, a TV, WiFi, a private bathroom, a ceiling fan and two beds. No smoking in the rooms. Included: private room, meals, 4 ayahuasca ceremonies, airport transfers, and 2 guided Amazon excursions. Not included: flights, visa, travel insurance. A $100 USD PayPal deposit is paid with the health application and is refunded if the application is declined for safety, or if the guest withdraws before the place is confirmed. The deposit does not confirm the retreat.

## Ceremonies

https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/ayahuasca-ceremonies/
https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/en/ayahuasca-ceremonies/

Four nights of ayahuasca, with rest between each one. Each night lasts 6 to 8 hours. Indigenous shamans lead the ceremonies with Denis Montes. Ceremonies are in English and Denis translates. They happen in the maloca at Calle Jaén 454, in the city of Iquitos, not in a remote jungle lodge. The shamans sing icaros. There may be visions, strong emotions, and physical purging such as vomiting or diarrhea. The centre does not promise an outcome. If the health application is not safe, the place is not confirmed.

## Safety

https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/safety/
https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/en/safety/

Adults 18 or older. A health application is required before a place is confirmed. The centre does not accept pregnancy or breastfeeding, antidepressants or MAOIs in use, antipsychotics or mood stabilizers, serious heart disease, uncontrolled high blood pressure, a history of psychosis, schizophrenia or bipolar disorder, epilepsy or other seizure disorders, or severe liver disease. Do not stop medication except with the prescribing doctor. When a doctor approves a pause, the published window is generally 4 to 6 weeks. Also declare St. John's wort, 5-HTP and tramadol. Clinics and hospitals in Iquitos are minutes away. Casa del Jaguar is not a hospital and does not provide medical insurance. Guests should bring travel insurance. If the ceremony is not safe, the $100 deposit is refunded.

## Diet

https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/diet/
https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/en/diet/

Start at least 14 days before arrival. Allowed: fresh fish (not canned), chicken, brown rice, quinoa, oats, fresh fruit, fresh vegetables, water, mild herbal teas. Avoid: red meat (pork, beef, lamb), dairy, alcohol, drugs, too much salt, refined sugar, processed food, strong spices, coffee, black tea, chocolate, fermented foods. Sexual abstinence for at least 3 days before a ceremony and 3 days after. Meals during the retreat follow this diet. The retreat includes 21 meals.

## Cancellation

https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/cancellation/
https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/en/cancellation/

Price is $2,800 USD. The $100 deposit is refunded if the application is declined for safety or withdrawn before the place is confirmed. After confirmation: more than 60 days, 90% refund; 30 to 60 days, 50% refund; under 30 days, no refund, and the date can move at no extra cost. A documented medical emergency is reviewed case by case.

## About

https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/about/
https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/en/about/

Dan Reynolds founded Casa del Jaguar in 2008 and led the ceremonies until 2014. He died in 2021. Since 2014 Denis Montes has led the ceremonies with indigenous shamans. Denis was born in Iquitos in 1983, is a chemical engineer (Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú 271557), met ayahuasca at 16 while working as a tour guide, and met Dan in 2011. The work is personal and spiritual. It is not medical treatment and does not replace a doctor or a psychiatrist.

https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/en/faqs/

The FAQ repeats the same facts: city location, 4 ceremonies, English with Denis translating, the two-week diet, the medicine rules, the $2,800 price, the room list, the group size of 8, and the cancellation schedule.

https://casadeljaguariquitos.com/en/booking/

The booking page is a health application: age, medicines including antidepressants and MAOIs, pregnancy, heart, blood pressure, seizures, psychosis or bipolar or schizophrenia, recent drug use, the guest's doctor, and a preferred date. The PayPal button on that page is the $100 deposit. Use the same name and email in PayPal as on the application. Contact: Calle Jaén 454, Iquitos. +51 917 811 803. info@casadeljaguariquitos.com.
